description:
KVK detail (basis profile)

Returns the KVK Handelsregister basis profile for an 8-digit KVK number.
Fields follow the KVK Handelsregister API: `kvkNummer`, `naam`,
`handelsnamen`, `sbiActiviteiten`, `_embedded.eigenaar`/`hoofdvestiging`
(including `rsin` and `rechtsvorm`), `adressen` and `links`. Current data
is always fetched from KVK; the local cache (48 hours) only serves repeated
requests within that window. `lastFetchedAt` shows when the data was last
retrieved from KVK. Optional: `vat=true`/`vies=true` derives the VAT number
from `rsin` and validates it via EU VIES (free, extra latency).

Cost: 2 credit(s) per call. An API key is required via the X-Api-Key header (or Authorization: Bearer <key>); a per-call wallet payment via x402 is also accepted.

vat.description: Add derived VAT data and optionally validate it via VIES (`vat=true`). Alias: `vies`.

vies.description: Alias for `vat`; validates VAT via VIES (`vies=true`).

name: kvk.detail
